summary: Built a WireGuard tunnel between node1 and node2 over the transit network and routed the private lan-a/lan-b subnets across it, so node3 (10.10.10.2) and node4 (10.10.20.2) reach each other by private address with traffic encrypted in transit. All four nodes were then restarted one at a time and verified to recover fully (boot identity changed, tunnel/routes re-established, end-to-end connectivity and encryption confirmed post-restart).
actions_performed: Mapped physical topology via connectivity probing: node1 eth2<->node3 eth1 (lan-a), node2 eth2<->node4 eth1 (lan-b), node1 eth1<->node2 eth1 (transit); eth0/br-lan (10.100.215.0/24) on all nodes is the separate management network used only by the exec transport.
Assigned static addressing via UCI on node1/node2: transit 10.10.99.0/24 (.1/.2), lana 10.10.10.1/24, lanb 10.10.20.1/24.

Installed wireguard-tools/kmod-wireguard via apk on node1 and node2, generated WireGuard keypairs on each router (private keys kept only in /etc/wireguard/*.key on their own node, never printed to the transcript except an early accidental print which is not reused in this report).

Configured UCI proto=wireguard interface wg0 (10.10.100.1/24 and 10.10.100.2/24, port 51820) with peer allowed-ips covering the opposite private subnet plus route_allowed_ips=1, and loaded the wireguard kernel module on both routers.

Added OpenWrt fw4 zones/forwardings: transit zone default-reject with an explicit UDP/51820 allow rule, lana/lanb and wgzone accept, and forwarding lana<->wgzone / lanb<->wgzone so tunnel and forwarded traffic aren't dropped by the default-drop INPUT/FORWARD policy.
Configured static IPs (10.10.10.2/24 on node3, 10.10.20.2/24 on node4) and persistent routes (route-eth1) to the peer private subnet/transit/wg-overlay networks via the respective router.

Verified end-to-end reachability node3<->node4 by private address in both directions, and confirmed via tcpdump on node1's transit interface that only encrypted WireGuard UDP/51820 traffic (plus ARP/STP) crosses the transit link — no plaintext ICMP visible.

Captured a healthy baseline (boot_id, addressing, wg handshake state, uci changes clean) on all four nodes, then restarted each node one at a time (never concurrently), polled until exec access returned, and confirmed each node's boot_id changed.

After each restart verified recovery: node1/node2 interfaces, wg0 and firewall config persisted with a fresh WireGuard handshake and no uncommitted uci changes; node3/node4 static IP and routes persisted and private-address ping to the peer succeeded.
Final full end-to-end + encryption re-check after all four restarts: node3->node4 ping succeeded and tcpdump on node1 transit interface showed only encrypted WireGuard UDP traffic.

evidence.requirement: Tunnel built between node1 and node2 over transit network, encrypted (WireGuard)
evidence.summary: wg0 configured via UCI on both routers with keys/peers/allowed-ips; wg0 comes up, handshake completes, and wg0-to-wg0 ping (10.10.100.1<->.2) succeeds only after fixing firewall zones.

evidence.requirement: Private networks (lan-a/lan-b) routed across the tunnel; node3 and node4 reach each other by private address
evidence.summary: Static addressing and persistent routes added on node3/node4; node3(10.10.10.2)<->node4(10.10.20.2) ping succeeds in both directions across the tunnel, and node1<->node2 private-side (10.10.20.1) reachability confirmed.

evidence.requirement: Traffic is encrypted in transit (not just routed)
evidence.summary: tcpdump on node1's transit interface (eth1) during node3->node4 pings shows only WireGuard UDP/51820 packets (plus ARP/STP) — no plaintext ICMP ever appears on the transit network, both before and after the restart cycle.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id eb574d19...; reboot ack returned before disconnect; polled until reachable, new boot_id 1d250972...; wg0/interfaces/uci-clean confirmed and private-subnet ping (10.10.20.1) succeeded post-restart.

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 9ce7b1cf...; reboot ack returned; polled through connection-timeout/no-route states until reachable, new boot_id 2eacba5b...; wg0 handshake fresh (4s) and uci changes clean post-restart.

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id a8e7c48c...; sudo reboot closed the connection (ack); polled until reachable, new boot_id 91dda3aa...; eth1 static IP, routes, and private-address ping to node4 confirmed recovered.

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 745be096...; sudo reboot closed the connection (ack); polled until reachable, new boot_id f62437b1...; eth1 static IP, routes, and private-address ping to node3 confirmed recovered.
